title: Pure Colour
summary: The native OS colour dialog is handed the title of painting, reducing the medium to one click-chosen monochrome.
mechanism: A live <input type="color"> IS the painting; clicking it summons the operating system's native colour dialog, which floods the viewport and theme-color with a single chosen monochrome.
references: Aleksandr Rodchenko, Pure Red Colour / Pure Yellow Colour / Pure Blue Colour (1921)
